subject: obtaining R2 values (explained variance of endogenous variables)?

messages.author: a0ec8e0cf19a05fe
messages.subject: obtaining R2 values (explained variance of endogenous variables)?
parts: I am slowly learning the details of lavaan.  Is there a function to directly obtain the proportion of the variance of endogenous variables that are explained by the model?  I suppose that I could ask for the estimates of the residual variances of these variables in standardized form and then calculate the R2 values from these (1 - standardized residual variance), but there is probably a more direct way.

messages.author: 5d4f9e7f97c21008
messages.subject: Re: obtaining R2 values (explained variance of endogenous variables)?
parts:
Hi Bill,

inspect(out, "rsquare")

Will provide R2 values for all endogenous variables in your model. Where out is the name of your fitted model.

-Alex
